blocks.text: Day 7 · A day in the wild, with activities at the pousada planned according to the season and the weather, accompanied by experienced local guides. Excursions take place mainly in the early morning and mid-afternoon, when it is cooler and wildlife is more active, and may include horseback riding, boat trips, trekking, birdwatching, piranha fishing, photo safaris and night-time caiman spotting. All excursions and meals are included during your stay. Overnight at the Pousada Aguapé.
